sources.quote: SUP-G,Minuterie Germanasca S.r.l.,"steel stampings, clips, pins"

findings.why: Viteria Lanzo does not appear in the supplier master, the qualification register or the capability register. Its standing and its capability for C67S spring steel cannot be checked. Owner: purchasing lead (G. Ferri) with the supplier quality manager (L. Bianchi).

sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers CL-115 for Aurelia only through Germanasca. Viteria Lanzo has no approval for this part, plant and customer.

sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: CL-115 is also used on PRG-Y for Nordhavn. The approved supplier list has no approval for Viteria Lanzo for this part, plant and customer.

sources.quote:
The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source

findings.why: CL-115 is on PRG-X, which belongs to Aurelia. A change of source needs Aurelia's written approval (PPAP) before shipment. Revision 4 replaces revision 3. Revision 4 also requires notification at least 90 days before implementation, and approval applies per part number and per site.

sources.quote:
A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before
the first shipment.

findings.why: CL-115 is also on PRG-Y, which belongs to Nordhavn. A change of source needs Nordhavn's approval before the first shipment.

sources.quote:
A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for
the drawing material.

findings.why: No 3.1 certificate for C67S from Viteria Lanzo is on file. Only Germanasca's certificate exists. Owner: supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo).
